## Findings
- TASK.md (xarray #2905): fixed in xarray/core/variable.py `as_compatible_data` — replaced blanket `getattr(data, "values", data)` with explicit `isinstance(data, (pd.Series, pd.Index, pd.DataFrame))` check (same as upstream commit c9b9eec7, present in this repo's history).
- Environment is numpy 2.5.4 / pandas 3.1.0 vs this old checkout: two import-blocking alias shims were required (dtypes.py np.unicode_→np.str_, missing.py np.float_→np.float64); pandas-3 CoW makes `pd.Series(...).values` read-only, so `_possibly_convert_objects` now restores writeability (mirrors upstream GH8843 fix).
- Regression proof: full suite (minus 3 test files that fail collection on test-file NumPy2/pandas3 code) baseline 825 fail-lines vs 823 with fix — 0 introduced, 2 fixed (test_unchanged_types, test_argmin_max_error).
